surfaces.name: Current
surfaces.description: Flat navy, a short emerald rule and open fact rows. The current polished design, unchanged.

surfaces.name: Spotlight
surfaces.description: A controlled emerald glow, lighter headlines and a fine frame around the numbers.

surfaces.name: Contour
surfaces.description: Wide, precise arcs on navy. Open typography and an emerald line running beside the facts.

surfaces.name: Editorial
surfaces.description: A pale paper field, navy type and deep emerald data. Fine rules give it an editorial rhythm.

surfaces.name: Emerald
surfaces.description: The brand green takes the whole canvas. Bold navy headlines and a contrasting field for the facts.

surfaces.name: Gridline
surfaces.description: A faint technical grid, compact bold type and structured data. A sharper, more playful expression.
